metas.name: Lady Macbeth
metas.description: A young woman sold into a loveless marriage in rural 19th-century England starts an affair and then kills to protect it. It's cold, spare and quietly vicious, and it ends on a chilling note.

metas.name: Sympathy for Mr. Vengeance
metas.description: Park Chan-wook's first vengeance film: a kidnapping meant to be harmless spirals into a chain of retribution. Cold, logical and devastating.

metas.name: The Skin I Live In
metas.description: Almodóvar's clinical thriller about a surgeon and the woman held captive in his house. The mid-film reveal recasts everything, and the ending pays it off.

metas.name: A Tale of Two Sisters
metas.description: Two sisters come home to a stepmother and a house that's wrong. A beautifully controlled Korean horror with a twist that cuts deep.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: A man imprisoned for 15 years without explanation is released and given five days to find out why. The revenge plot builds to one of cinema's cruelest reveals.

metas.name: The Invisible Man
metas.description: A woman escapes her controlling partner, then becomes convinced he's still with her. Gaslighting turned into precise, escalating horror.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: A banished Puritan family on the edge of a forest turns on itself as something picks off its members. Slow, exact, and dread that never lets up.

metas.name: Possessor
metas.description: A corporate assassin who works by taking over other people's bodies loses her grip on herself. Brandon Cronenberg's cold, savage sci-fi horror.

metas.name: Insomnia
metas.description: A sleepless detective covers up his own mistake while a calm killer blackmails him. A tight moral squeeze under a sun that never sets.

metas.name: Blood Simple
metas.description: The Coens' debut: a jealous bar owner hires a sleazy detective to kill his wife, and every double-cross makes it worse.
